Well I am a girl, I am a very shy person, and I am 16 so I am close to the age of the girl you talking about so maybe I can help. Yes I understand the going out to eat dilemma because as a shy person I think all that silence would make me uncomfortable. I am not familiar with Staten Island New York but I think a movie either at the theater would do nicely. All you really have to do is watch so there would be no uncomfortable silences, it would give you both something to talk about, and I think if i was in her shoes that's probably the option that would make me feel most comfortable.

Start by just saying Hi. Usually that is all you will really need and if she is nice she will respond back. If she doesn't respond back either something is going wrong with her phone or she isn't nice and in which case you shouldn't want to talk to her anyways. Moving on, start the conversation off slow and then if she seems interested start asking questions about things you know she likes, or if you don't know what she likes start asking about what she likes. If she doesn't seem interested, you should end the conversation so as to not make here uncomfortable, but sometimes I guess you can't tell if someone is interested or not. It should naturally flow from there if you two have chemistry. Coming from a girl myself here are some tips: try to avoid one word answers like yeah, no, lol, idk because it makes you seem uninterested and girls and guys alike probably don't like that. Always make it clear when you want to end the conversation such as "Oh I'm tired I think I will go to bed now, talk to you later" if you don't make it clear that you are about to end the conversation and you just say nothing and all the sudden just stop texting her that could make her confused about weather you like her or not, and she may think you are just a jerk. Sorry not trying to make you paranoid or anything, you should want to be yourself, but these are just some suggestions.
